content: {"like":["Prefers visually striking, monochrome aesthetics with an odd, entrancing style","Values lifelike marionettes and monotone voiceovers that enhance atmosphere","Enjoys captivating storytelling that keeps viewers engaged","Appreciates well-packaged, promptly delivered media with high-quality CGI and unique stop‑motion art","Favors performances with strong vocal presence and expressive characters, especially in TV series"],"dislike":["Dislikes poor disc quality, jittery edges, ghosting vocals, and mismatched lip sync","Rejects repetitive, undistinguished songs and overly long films","Criticizes limited facial expressions and lack of emotional range in actors","Finds certain voice casting choices (e.g., Moana, Maui) inappropriate or weak","Disapproves of unconvincing dance sequences and light comedy that doesn't suit the actor"]}
